plugins.name: dsh-base
plugins.description: The shared dsh core as a profile bundle: every profile's first patch layer, inserting the base plugin rows over the empty profile root

plugins.name: dsh-web-app
plugins.description: The browser-surface bundle: the web patch layer over dsh-base plus the runtime glue plugin (frontend dist serving, web-surface prompt, URL line)

plugins.name: dsh-headless
plugins.description: The one-shot bundle: a direct core Agent/Session runner over dsh-base with no Host, HTTP, or browser layer

plugins.name: dsh-hooks-claude-code
plugins.description: Bridge plugin: runs an existing Claude Code hooks.json on the harness interception seams (command hooks only; http, mcp_tool, prompt, and agent hooks are skipped with a warning)

plugins.name: dsh-hooks-codex
plugins.description: Bridge plugin: runs a Codex hooks.json on the harness interception seams (regex-only matchers, snake_case payloads, only blocking decisions honored)

plugins.name: modlens
plugins.description: Vision plugin for text-only models: image understanding bridged into the harness via a dsh.bundle patch layer, shipping a modlens skill alongside

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui
plugins.description: Plugin and skin collection for the dsh Web UI: task board, git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, live token stats, and a skin center that routes around the theme-persistence gap

plugins.name: colleague-skill
plugins.description: Digital-companion skill in the Anthropic SKILL.md format dsh reads; install by copying it into a dsh skill root such as .agents/skills

plugins.name: dsh-ui-status-label
plugins.description: Web UI plugin that makes the assistant's thinking status label ('deep diving') user-configurable through settings

plugins.name: dsh-turn-rewind
plugins.description: Rewind conversation and workspace state to a previous turn, backed by a persistent change ledger

plugins.name: dsh-vision-toolkit
plugins.description: Harness-native integration of agent-vision-toolkit for text-only models: image Q&A with intent, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, grounding, and pixel diff

plugins.name: dsh-cc-tui
plugins.description: Claude Code-style fullscreen terminal UI: streaming thinking, double-Esc rewind, context progress bar, and TPS meter over the headless runner

plugins.name: dsh-tianshu-tui
plugins.description: Terminal UI for dsh shipped as an installable profile bundle

plugins.name: oh-dsh
plugins.description: Community distribution bundling TUI, desktop, and web UI surfaces with layered installation, pinned to an exact harness revision via dsh-source.json

plugins.name: dsh-workflow
plugins.description: Workflow layer that upgrades one-shot multi-agent dispatch into savable, governable, observable, and resumable workflows

plugins.name: dsh-ads
plugins.description: Satirical 2005-portal fake-ad plugin for the web UI (sidebar ads, in-conversation feed, corner popups); ad slots also surface real dsh-plugin topic repos

plugins.name: dsh-visualize
plugins.description: Generative UI in conversation: a visualize tool plus companion skill renders interactive HTML cards in sandboxed frames with streaming preview

plugins.name: dsh-agent-teams
plugins.description: AgentTeams plugin: coordinate teams of subagents from the web UI

plugins.name: dsh-at-file
plugins.description: Codex-style @file mentions in the composer: search workspace files and attach their contents to prompts

plugins.name: dsh-better-sidebar
plugins.description: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering/editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party extensions can register new tabs

plugins.name: dsh-custom-tool
plugins.description: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and a model-driven tool lifecycle

plugins.name: dsh-notification
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and include/exclude keyword rules

plugins.name: dsh-open-in-vscode
plugins.description: Open workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI

plugins.name: dsh-openpencil
plugins.description: OpenPencil design preview and editing inside the web UI

plugins.name: whale-girl
plugins.description: Desktop-pet companion for the web GUI (QQ-pet style): draggable, feedable, levels up with session activity; migrated from the removed .dsh-plugin format to dsh.bundle

plugins.name: dsh-deep-whale
plugins.description: Whale-girl skin series for the web UI; maid-atelier ships as a dsh.bundle package installed from a local clone (CC BY-NC-SA, non-commercial)

plugins.name: find-plugins
plugins.description: Skill that discovers and installs dsh plugins from the GitHub dsh-plugin topic, verifying install method from repo manifests; copy skills/find-plugins into a skill root

plugins.name: harmony-next
plugins.description: HarmonyOS NEXT development skill with offline ArkTS/ArkUI references and DevEco automation; copy harmony-next/ into a dsh skill root

plugins.name: mstar-harness
plugins.description: Morning Star skill-driven engineering workflow (roles, phase gates, plan conventions) shipped as twenty SKILL.md units; copy skills/* into a dsh skill root

plugins.name: ex-skill
plugins.description: Builds a digital persona skill of your ex from WeChat chat logs (create-ex); SKILL.md documents dsh discovery paths alongside other hosts

plugins.name: argo
plugins.description: Agent-first multilingual search and evidence-verification skill routing 120+ engines with vertical sources and MCP entry points; SKILL.md at repo root
